combinations.magnitude: HDCA had no analgesic effect in Fxr-/- mice (ns)
combinations.evidence_quote: HDCA supplementation did not alleviate mechanical or thermal hyperalgesia induced by FXR deficiency (Fig. 12I, J).

combinations.readout: spinal PPAR-γ, MMP-2 and MMP-9 expression
combinations.magnitude: HDCA failed to reverse MMP-2/MMP-9 activation or restore PPAR-γ in Fxr-/- mice
combinations.evidence_quote: Furthermore, HDCA treatment failed to reverse the activation of MMP-2 and MMP-9 or to restore PPAR-γ expression levels following FXR gene knockout (Fig. 12L, M).
